title: One account standing from the record and billing
assertion: `standingKind` and `accountStanding` give good only for an active record in good billing standing; a suspended record reads "Suspended by PaidWhole" whatever billing's standing, with the date PaidWhole suspended it, when one is stored, a support ticket (`/support?from=billing`) as its next step and the note that changing the plan or payment method does not reinstate it, in the word ("reinstates") the practice home uses; a closed record reads "Closed" whatever else, in the neutral tone and a status unless an invoice is still owed, takes no new plan (the plan route refuses it before Stripe is asked, and again in the claim's own statement), offers the ticket for a question about the closure and never promises a reopening, and names an unpaid invoice as still owed with no claim about runs; an active record suspended for nonpayment names billing's date and the invoice holding it (`billing_standing.invoice_id`, even past the newest 24), and says a card payment restarts runs at once and a bank (ACH) payment once the bank settles it, and with several invoices unpaid for 30 days (counted by the view's own predicate) asks for all of them paid and restarts runs only then, so paying the holding one leaves runs refused and names the next; past due names its date, the instant runs stop (UTC) and that a bank (ACH) payment counts once settled; beside a suspension, an unpaid invoice is named with what it holds (a past-due one stops runs at its stop even once reinstated) and paying it is a second step; a firm is never told its unpaid invoice stops runs, and its unpaid invoice reads past due; every non-good standing has a notice and a next step; the page draws one badge from the label, one alert or status and one `data-standing`, with no second date, shows the placeholder-price note only beside prices, offers a closed organization no plan in the invoices' empty state, and keeps the Pay target clear of the sticky header; the console shows and orders by the same kind, in the same words ("Suspended by PaidWhole", a firm's billing hold as past due), with closed outlined
noFileReason: accountStanding and standingKind are pure functions of values the test passes in memory, and the routes read synthetic organizations; no file.
